Wayback CDX of iafs2023.com.au* recovered the final scientific programme PDF (a title/presenter grid with no IDs) and the mini-oral programme; the programme grid parse (pdftohtml -xml, font 2 titles vs font 3 names) yields 450 oral items but merges adjacent cells, so it is recorded only as a lower bound.
